scenes.narration: Someone at the back door says they have water. You haven't opened it. Not yet.
You crouch down and look through the gap at the bottom. Two shoes. Standing perfectly still.
scenes.visual: view under the door: two shoes

scenes.narration: Then one of them... turns the wrong way.

scenes.visual: you step back from the door

scenes.narration: The knocking goes on for an hour. Then it stops. And somehow... the silence is worse.
Here's the thing nobody tells you about survival. It's called the rule of threes.
Three minutes without air. Three hours without shelter in bad weather. Three days without water. Three weeks without food.
scenes.visual: RULE OF THREES card with four lines

scenes.narration: You've got weeks of food. But water... you've got two bottles. And it's day three.
You give Mia most of it. She notices. She always notices.
By night, her lips are dry. She's dizzy. She keeps saying she's fine.
Then the shutter at the front starts to rattle. Then bend.
You search every shelf again. Sports drinks, gone. Soda, gone. Even the ice in the freezer, gone.
There's water in this building. A lot of it. You just have to know where. Where's water? Tell me in the comments... part three is up next.
